description: LEP-0003 §3 / SPEC.md §9 pinned contact-hash preimage->digest pairs (the dedup-hash reference vectors, #153 T9 starting set). Every SDK dedup/contacted-hash builder and the reference platform MUST reproduce each digest byte-exactly; divergence kills cross-pair dedup silently, so these rows are the interop guarantee the prose cannot provide. Recompute rule: lowercase-hex HMAC-SHA256 over UTF-8 bytes: hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), preimage.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(). Naming note: LEP-0003 §3 proposed the file name dedup-hash.json; this lane lands the identical fixture form under test-vectors/sdk/contact-hash.json.
encoding: utf-8 (secret and preimage); output lowercase hex

preimage_rules.phone: Verbatim wire bytes: the consumer.phone string exactly as delivered on the post (E.164 by core schema on conforming traffic); no folding, stripping, or reformatting (LEP-0003 §3; the reference platform's messages.py builder is the executed baseline).
preimage_rules.email: Proposed canonical (pin-in-progress): trim surrounding whitespace, ASCII-lowercase the domain, keep local-part bytes verbatim, plus-addresses distinct. GATED: no email-form contacted_hashes entry ships until SPEC.md §9's pin is confirmed and the executed #153 T9 vectors publish; the reference platform hashes phone only today.
